title: Data I/O Corporation Announces 2025 Annual Meeting of Shareholders
summary: Data I/O Corporation (NASDAQ: DAIO) today announced that its 2025 Annual Meeting of Shareholders will be held on May 20, 2025.
body_markdown: Data I/O Corporation (NASDAQ: DAIO) today announced that its 2025 Annual Meeting of Shareholders will be held on May 20, 2025.
